summary: Comprehensive testing of Vakar Games v1.2.0 bug fixes. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). context_for_next_testing_agent: All v1.2.0 bug fixes verified working. Key changes: (1) API Docs page now has full dark theme, (2) Admin Panel link removed from all public pages (Home, Games, Blog), (3) Mobile hamburger menu added to all public pages, (4) Maintenance mode blocks public routes (/, /games, /blog) while /login and /dashboard still work, (5) Homepage shows single featured game instead of 3 Coming Soon cards, (6) Games Management has 'Featured Game' checkbox and 'web'/'android' platform options. Platform options are now: steam, google_play, apple, pc, web, android.
